newsitem.title: USA: NBC says close to signing deal with Brokaw.
newsitem.headline: NBC says close to signing deal with Brokaw.

text.p: General Electric Co's NBC unit said Wednesday it was close to signing a new contract with television news anchorman Tom Brokaw.

"We're near, but there's nothing to be announced yet," said a NBC News spokeswoman. "It will be done before the week is through." The spokeswoman said there were a few minor details to be worked out before a deal was finalized.
Brokaw was not immediately available for comment.
NBC denied a Washington Post report that NBC would announce Wednesdday a five-year deal with Brokaw.
Brokaw has reportedly been wooed by Time Warner Inc's CNN network with an offer of $8 million per year. Published reports said NBC was offering Brokaw about $7 million annually.
